FAQ

We have the answers

Start with your database, your goals, and your sales process. We shape the setup around what your business needs.

The basics

Conversations

Setup & integrations

Controls & support

What makes SmartAi Sales different?

The focus is on the opportunity in the leads you already have. We configure personal conversations around your business, then bring interested prospects back to the people who can help them.

How does the AI help day to day?

It restarts conversations, responds with approved information, asks qualification questions, and helps move interested leads toward a useful next step. Your team stays focused on the relationship.

Does it replace our sales team?

No. Your AI starts the conversation and handles repetitive follow-up. Your people bring judgment, build trust, handle complex needs, and close the deal.

What problem does it solve?

Businesses often have a database of past enquiries that nobody has time to revisit. SmartAi Sales helps restart those conversations and find out who may be ready to talk now.

Who is SmartAi Sales for?

Businesses with an existing lead database, a clear offer, and a team that wants help with consistent follow-up. We explore your use case before recommending a campaign.

What is SmartAi Sales?

SmartAi Sales is a database reactivation service that uses AI conversations to reconnect with old leads, understand interest, and move qualified opportunities toward your team.
